What We Design

Eight connected areas shape a comfortable visit and a practical working salon.

01

Styling Station Layout

Comfortable spacing, clear sightlines and efficient movement around every chair.

02

Treatment & Facial Rooms

Private, calm rooms with the right storage, lighting and service access.

03

Waiting Lounge Design

A welcoming pause that feels relaxed without crowding the reception zone.

04

Reception & Retail Display

One clear arrival point with products placed naturally in the client journey.

05

Salon Lighting Design

Flattering, accurate light for styling work, mirrors and comfortable waiting.

06

Plumbing & Backwash Zones

Backwash positions coordinated with water, drainage and staff circulation.

07

Brand Styling & Décor

Colour, finishes and details that make the salon feel recognisably yours.

08

Facade & Signage

A clear street presence that helps clients find and remember the salon.

01 / 08

Our Design Process

Five focused stages take the salon from first conversation to an approved design package.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We discuss services, client profile, station count, brand, budget and opening plan.

02

Site Measurement

We record the floor, frontage, plumbing points, services and existing conditions.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Stations, rooms, reception and movement come together in one clear plan.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

Durable finishes, salon furniture, lighting and brand details are coordinated.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

Drawings and 3D views prepare the salon for confident pricing and execution.

Pricing

The initial consultation and site survey are free. We provide an exact fixed quote after the survey, once the station count, treatment rooms and 3D package are clear.

Salon Design FAQs

Straight answers on client comfort, station capacity, plumbing, timing, branding and 3D approval.

fields.copy: Straight answers on client comfort, station capacity, plumbing, timing, branding and 3D approval.

items.q: How can salon design keep clients coming back?
items.a: A calm arrival, comfortable stations, flattering light and privacy in treatment areas make each visit feel considered and easy to repeat.

items.q: How many styling stations fit my salon?
items.a: Capacity depends on floor area, circulation, storage and service mix. We test layouts before confirming a practical station count.

items.q: How do you plan plumbing for backwash units?
items.a: We position backwash units around water supply, drainage, access and staff movement, then coordinate the required plumbing routes.

items.q: How long does salon design take?
items.a: A compact salon commonly takes two to three weeks. Larger salons with several treatment rooms need more time for coordination and approvals.

items.q: Can the design match my salon brand?
items.a: Yes. Colour, materials, lighting, signage, furniture and retail displays are shaped around the brand without making the space feel forced.

items.q: Do I receive 3D visuals before execution?
items.a: Yes. Key styling, reception, waiting and treatment areas are shown in 3D before site work begins.
